# clio setup

Configure the stack and write the deployment config the binary reads (see `clio setup --help` for the full flag set)

## Usage

```
clio setup [--database managed|sqlite|existing] [--config PATH] [--db-path PATH] [--database-url ADDRESS] [--database-connect pasted|typed] [--database-host H] [--database-port P] [--database-name N] [--database-user U] [--database-password P] [--database-ssl MODE] [--database-ssl-rootcert PATH] [--database-option NAME=VALUE]... [--embed local|online] [--embed-url U] [--embed-model M] [--embed-key K] [--embed-provider tei|openai] [--embed-dims N] [--rerank local|online|skip] [--rerank-url U] [--rerank-model M] [--rerank-key K] [--rerank-provider tei|cohere] [--extract local|skip|online] [--compose-dir DIR] [--key-store file|keystore] [--sync-store file|keystore] [--allow-untested] [--yes] [--non-interactive] [--interactive]
```

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--database managed\|docker\|sqlite\|file\|existing\|external` | enum: managed, docker, sqlite, file, existing, external |  | Database route `setup_flows_db::ask_database` takes. |
| `--config PATH` | text |  | Deployment config path `setup_cli::run` resolves; the XDG config path decides it when absent. |
| `--db-path PATH` | text |  | SQLite file `setup_flows_db::ask_sqlite` opens; the standard data path decides it when absent. |
| `--database-url ADDRESS` | text |  | Postgres address `setup_flows_db_paste::ask_pasted` keeps as given. |
| `--database-connect pasted\|paste\|typed\|details` | enum: pasted, paste, typed, details |  | Existing-Postgres route `setup_flows_db_paste::ask_handover` takes. |
| `--database-host H` | text |  | Host `setup_flows_db_typed` reads and checks. |
| `--database-port P` | text |  | Port, or a comma-separated port list, `setup_flows_db_typed` reads and checks. |
| `--database-name N` | text |  | Database name `setup_flows_db_typed` reads and checks. |
| `--database-user U` | text |  | Username `setup_flows_db_typed` reads and checks. |
| `--database-password P` | text |  | Password `setup_flows_db_typed` reads for the existing route. |
| `--database-ssl MODE` | enum: disable, prefer, verify-full, encrypt-no-verify |  | SSL mode `setup_flows_db_fields::ask_ssl` reads; the host decides the default. |
| `--database-ssl-rootcert PATH` | text |  | Root certificate `setup_flows_db_typed` trusts in a verifying mode. |
| `--database-option NAME=VALUE` | text |  | Advanced libpq setting `setup_flows_db_typed::flagged_advanced` validates; repeatable. |
| `--embed local\|online\|hosted\|remote\|skip\|none\|off` | enum: local, online, hosted, remote, skip, none, off |  | Embedding role `setup_step_ask::ask_role` takes. |
| `--embed-url U` | text |  | Embedding endpoint `setup_step_ask` checks and records. |
| `--embed-model M` | text |  | Embedding model `setup_step_ask` records for the endpoint. |
| `--embed-key K` | text |  | Embedding API key `setup_step_ask` reads for the endpoint. |
| `--embed-provider tei\|openai` | enum: tei, openai |  | Embedding provider `setup_step_ask::service_provider` restricts. |
| `--embed-dims N` | uint |  | Hosted embedding dimensions `setup_cli::preflight` requires above zero. |
| `--rerank local\|online\|hosted\|remote\|skip\|none\|off` | enum: local, online, hosted, remote, skip, none, off |  | Reranking role `setup_step_ask::ask_role` takes. |
| `--rerank-url U` | text |  | Reranking endpoint `setup_step_ask` checks and records. |
| `--rerank-model M` | text |  | Reranking model `setup_step_ask` records for the endpoint. |
| `--rerank-key K` | text |  | Reranking API key `setup_step_ask` reads for the endpoint. |
| `--rerank-provider tei\|cohere` | enum: tei, cohere |  | Reranking provider `setup_step_ask::service_provider` restricts. |
| `--extract local\|skip\|none\|online\|hosted` | enum: local, skip, none, online, hosted |  | Extraction role `setup_step_extract::ask_extract` takes. |
| `--compose-dir DIR` | text |  | Compose root `setup_verify::start_and_check` uses; the cwd decides it when absent. |
| `--key-store file\|keystore` | enum: file, keystore |  | Encryption key store `setup_key_source::ask` takes. |
| `--sync-store file\|keystore` | enum: file, keystore |  | Sync key store `setup_sync_key_source::ask` takes. |
| `--allow-untested` |  |  | Saves answers after a failed test in `setup_flows_db::finish`. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Forces non-interactive mode in `setup_cli::interactive_mode`. |
| `--non-interactive` |  |  | Forces non-interactive mode in `setup_cli::interactive_mode`. |
| `--interactive` |  |  | Requires a terminal in `setup_cli::interactive_mode`. |

## Examples

Answer every question for a SQLite store, local embedding, and no reranker, then run without prompting.
```
clio setup --database sqlite --db-path ./memory.db --embed local --rerank skip --non-interactive
```

Configure only the SQLite store, with no embedding or reranking service.
```
clio setup --database sqlite --db-path ./memory.db --embed skip --rerank skip --non-interactive
```

Write the deployment config to an explicit path instead of the default.
```
clio setup --database sqlite --db-path ./memory.db --embed local --rerank skip --config ./deployment.json --non-interactive
```
